title: Selvage Session Protocol — the `GET /meta` body
description: The body `GET /meta` answers with, on the same listener as the session WebSocket. It is JSON but not a session frame: no `v`, no envelope, no `id`. Valid against PROTOCOL.md §2.

capabilities.description: The same list the handshake reply advertises: the two names this protocol defines for a server.

keepalive.description: The session's clocks plus `room_grace_ms`, which `/meta` carries and the handshake reply does not (PROTOCOL.md §2).

server.description: Free-form server identification, e.g. `selvaged/0.4.0`. Not stable; nothing may depend on it.

wire_versions.description: The wire versions this server accepts, which is `["selvage/2"]`: a list with one entry, and a member that stays a list because a later version has to be able to say so.
